result.decision_rationale: The focused gate passed on the exact candidate. Three toolbar paths still violate the mission. A save between two native slot reads can replace the chosen canonical slot with an older alias, bulk cleanup can select the last of two canonical bindings, and saving while KMC is disabled can carry placement intent into another loaded world. These are source-level defects that can be checked offline.

required_gaps: Cover a save between canonical GetSlot cleanup and cleanup of a secondary alias.
Cover bulk cleanup of two canonical bindings using the same first-slot precedence as archive capture.
Cover disabled save sanitation followed by another load and re-enable with matching actor and pet identities.

The city changes project existing pet instances into the capital roster. The combat changes carry an explicit order on an already-unconscious living target through mounted admission. Native panel selection, equipment interaction and attack rolls remain owner observations.

findings.actual: GetSlot(4) records interrupted intent at 4. At the save header, RecoverLegacyAlias preserves that entry, but ObserveArrangementOnBar immediately scans again. PublicBindingIndex now finds only the alias at 9, and ObserveAtBoundary calls ObserveBound at 9. With both facts unavailable, capture marks 9 interrupted and writes it as the kind-6 row. The new guard in ObserveNativeAliasInvalidated is never reached in this order.
findings.blocking_rationale: The slot restored from the same older bar still depends on whether native UI reads one slot or cleans the whole bar before saving.
findings.expected: The save carries the canonical choice at 4, and the same pet's return restores one shortcut there.
findings.requested_correction: Preserve the observed canonical choice when classifying a surviving secondary alias at the save boundary. Keep recovery of a genuine alias-only bar and recognition of player moves.
findings.requested_evidence: Use the existing mixed-bar fixture with the pet temporarily unresolved. Deliver GetSlot cleanup for 4 only, leave the stale alias at 9, then save. Require one kind-6 row at 4 and one restored shortcut there after reload and pet return. Retain the full-pass and alias-only controls.
findings.title: A save between native slot reads can still replace the canonical choice with an older alias
findings.trigger: An older bar has a stale canonical binding at 4 and a stale Mount alias at 9. Native GetSlot empties 4, and a save starts before native reads 9.

findings.actual: Each canonical emptying calls ObserveNativeSlotInvalidated with its own index. The first call records 3 and the second calls ObserveBound at 9, replacing 3. Once both slots are empty, capture writes 9. Saving the bar before cleanup selects 3 under RecoveredPublicSlot.
findings.blocking_rationale: A toolbar shape already covered by the candidate's compatibility tests restores at different indices depending on cleanup timing.
findings.expected: Native cleanup preserves the first canonical index selected by the existing repair and archive policy.
findings.requested_correction: Resolve cleanup reports against the bar's selected public binding so a secondary canonical report cannot replace the first choice. Preserve recovery of a single manually moved shortcut.
findings.requested_evidence: Extend the existing two-canonical fixture at 3 and 9. Make the fact unavailable, empty both slots in one cleanup pass, save and reload. Require one public row and one restored shortcut at 3, matching capture before cleanup.
findings.title: Bulk cleanup selects the last of two canonical shortcuts
findings.trigger: The bar contains canonical bindings at 3 and 9, as in StaleThenCurrentCanonical. The same pet becomes temporarily unavailable and CleanupBadSlots empties both before capture.

findings.actual: BeginSaveSerializationScope runs ObserveArrangementsAtBoundary while disabled. A surviving public slot on a candidate rider adds a placement record and intent, and RemoveManagedFacts marks the intent interrupted. On the next disabled load, MountedControlLoadFence.Begin calls Release and returns without clearing those live collections. Re-enabling can therefore restore the previous world's slot for the same rider and pet even with autofill off.
findings.blocking_rationale: A save made with KMC disabled can determine the toolbar arrangement in a different save.
findings.expected: Disabled saves sanitize surviving KMC bindings without acquiring recoverable placement state. A replacement world starts with its own arrangement.
findings.requested_correction: Keep disabled save sanitation active while preventing it from recording toolbar intent. Ensure a disabled selected load clears any live placement records from the outgoing world.
findings.requested_evidence: While disabled, save an older world with a surviving shortcut at 9 on a party rider before UI cleanup. Verify sanitation removes the binding and leaves both placement collections empty. Load a world with the same rider and pet IDs and no shortcut rows, then enable with autofill off and verify slot 9 stays empty.
findings.title: Disabled save sanitation can carry a shortcut into another world
findings.trigger: While KMC is disabled, an older save supplies a surviving canonical or legacy shortcut. The player saves before native toolbar cleanup, then loads another save while KMC is still disabled.

prior_finding_assessments.rationale: Successful canonical emptying now marks placement in the live or fenced outgoing set. FirstManualCleanupNoAutofill covers an occupied slot, another empty main-bar slot, save and reload.

MixedCleanupPassKeepsCanonical covers both slots being emptied in one pass. A save after GetSlot empties only the canonical slot still lets the secondary alias overwrite the same choice through ObserveAtBoundary.
CaptureAbsentIntent applies the same occupancy decision to the archive and the continuing arrangement. OccupiedSlotGivenUpEverywhere checks both paths after the occupant is cleared.

A disabled load no longer arms a fence or retains the outgoing Player, and both native cleanup entry points check the enabled state. DisabledLifecycle exercises the fence lifetime and cleanup cases. R15-F2 concerns a separate writer during save sanitation.
A fenced native rebind now records live intent and placement in the outgoing scope. FencedRebindAbandoned covers removal after abandonment and isolation after completed replacement.

Four prior fixes are verified. Toolbar precedence and disabled-save isolation still need correction.
